trust_decision.summary: Before anything is signed, the wallet must reconcile the outputs produced by storage with the caller's request: each caller-requested output must come back unchanged (script and satoshis), and every additional output must be client-derived change or at most one bounded storage commission. The decision is made in the client signer (buildSignableTransaction) and, per the advisory's own defence-in-depth note, is also expected of WalletPermissionsManager.createAction.

landing_point.why: The existing storage-output guard and the loop that copies storage-supplied locking scripts into the signed transaction are in this one function; an engineer reading 'wallet does not verify storage-supplied recipient outputs in createAction' lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: Wallet.createAction (packages/wallet/wallet-toolbox/src/Wallet.ts:899 -> signer/methods/createAction.ts:85); call already present at the pinned commit

fix_sites.module_kind: library signer / transaction builder (new call to the injection guard)

fix_sites.entry_point: Wallet.createAction (reaches the new exported verifyUnrequestedOutputsAreChangeOrCommission through buildSignableTransaction)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: WalletPermissionsManager is only defence-in-depth (its own comment defers to the signer) and cannot re-derive change scripts, so a solver can argue the wrapper is not expected to police outputs beyond the caller's.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Client-derived change outputs (providedBy 'storage', purpose 'change') may carry any amount and any storage-supplied script because buildSignableTransaction replaces the script with makeChangeLock, and honest storage legitimately appends one service-charge output of a configured amount; a fix that requires every signed output to be listed in args.outputs breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: missing caller output (storage returns fewer outputs than requested)
caller output reclassified as providedBy 'storage' or purpose 'change'
altered satoshi amount on a caller output
extra unrequested output with an unrecognized purpose/providedBy label
second commission output (more than one allowed)
custom (lower) commission cap passed by the caller
zero caller-requested outputs (only change/commission remain to be checked)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WalletPermissionsManager.createAction returns as soon as the underlying wallet produced no signableTransaction, so its output verification never runs on the signAndProcess path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only an admin originator can force signAndProcess=true, and by then the transaction is already signed and processed by our own wallet
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same method (~15 lines above the existing check)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The spending-authorization line items and netSpent are computed from args.outputs, so an output injected by storage (funded out of change) is never shown to the user who approves the spend
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: netSpend only needs the caller's own outflow and the fee; verifying the transaction body is the signer's job
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~160 lines below the createAction verification block

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reconcile the StorageCreateActionResult returned over RPC with the args that were sent, inside the remote storage client
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This class is the actual trust boundary against a remote storage operator; a maintainer hardening the client would naturally validate the response before returning it to the signer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Server-side assertion that the persisted/echoed output set equals the requested outputs plus the server's own commission and change
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The honest storage handler already builds both sides of the comparison (validateRequiredOutputs and createNewOutputs), so a server-side consistency assertion is a small, natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second build path (or an isSignAction-specific branch) that re-checks the storage result before handing it to buildSignableTransaction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: createNewTx is the only call site, and a maintainer adding a retry/alternate provider path would add the check here rather than inside the builder.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Sanitize the output descriptor (purpose/providedBy labels) in the mapper that serializes a stored output for the client
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The whole client-side injection check trusts these two labels; a maintainer could normalize or derive them in this mapper so a compromised row cannot smuggle a label.

O9_family: Improper validation of consistency within input (CWE-1288): the outputs returned by storage are not reconciled with the caller-requested outputs, so a substituted or injected recipient is signed and broadcast

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm 10.33.2 monorepo, Node >= 22, tsc --build, jest 30 + ts-jest, ts-standard lint
O10_build.project_tests: packages/wallet/wallet-toolbox/src/signer/methods/__tests/buildSignableTransaction.verify.test.ts (pure jest unit test of the guard) and packages/wallet/wallet-toolbox/src/__tests/WalletPermissionsManager.outputVerification.test.ts; integration createAction tests under packages/wallet/wallet-toolbox/test/wallet/action/ need a local SQLite/MySQL storage but not the network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Require every signed output to appear in args.outputs (or compare the tx output set to the request), which rejects the client-derived change output and the honest storage commission and breaks every createAction that produces change.
